title: Golden set
description: The question set of record. One case names documents, never chunks, so a chunking change does not rewrite the set. `stratum` is mandatory: a metric reported over one aggregate hides the stratum that broke.

id.description: Stable slug. Renaming a case destroys comparability with earlier measurements.

question.description: Phrased the way a new hire asks it, not in the words of the document.

audience.description: The viewer's audience for this case.

stratum.description: fact: one document answers. neardup: a competing near-duplicate exists. multihop: two or more documents answer. acl: a relevant document exists and must stay hidden. escalation: must escalate, no hidden document involved. injection: an attack, not a question. unanswerable: no document holds the fact. morphology: degraded phrasing — typos, no keywords, scrambled word order.

expect_docs.description: Documents that must reach the top five. Empty for escalation-only cases.

expect_absent_docs.description: Documents that must never reach the top five: other audiences, expired editions, never-indexed drafts.

expect_contains.description: Full phrases with the number and its unit, not bare digits. A bare `3` matches `3 hours, 14 days`.

expect_not_contains.description: Phrases that mark a wrong answer even when the expected phrase is present: the other edition's number, the draft's number. Mandatory for a neardup case.

expect_reason.description: Omitted means any escalation reason is accepted; a named one is asserted.
